name: Fiona A. McCormick
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Waukegan, Illinois
about: A partner at Del Re Law Group, P.C., based in Waukegan, Illinois, Fiona A. McCormick provides experienced legal representation to individuals and families navigating sensitive domestic relations matters. Her practice focuses exclusively on family law, helping clients address complex legal transitions with compassion and diligence. With decades of legal experience, she is committed to helping clients navigate difficult disputes while pursuing practical and effective solutions tailored to their unique needs.

Throughout her career, Ms. McCormick has developed extensive experience handling domestic relations litigation and negotiations. She works closely with clients through every stage of the legal process, advocating for their best interests both inside and outside the courtroom. Her deep understanding of family law and dedication to constructive resolution enable her to provide strategic counsel and dedicated support during challenging times.

Ms. McCormick earned her Bachelor of Arts degree magna cum laude from Carroll College before receiving her Juris Doctor from Valparaiso University School of Law. Admitted to practice law in Illinois in 2005, she is also admitted before the Supreme Court of the United States. Multilingual and versatile in her communication, she is fluent in both English and American Sign Language, enabling her to assist a diverse clientele.

Demonstrating an active commitment to the legal community, Ms. McCormick maintains memberships in several prominent professional organizations. She serves as a member of the Jefferson American Inn of Court, an assembly member and family law section member of the Illinois State Bar Association, a family law section member of the Lake County Bar Association, and a member of the Association of Women Attorneys of Lake County.
office: 200 N. Martin Luther King, Jr. Ave.
